## Structure and components

- [statement] Publisher Frank West describes checking card counts, ordering and duplicates against the rulebook’s component list. This is a concrete completeness-and-collation check, separate from judging print appearance. (low confidence) — https://thecityofkings.com/news/requesting-samples-from-your-manufacturer/ · keywords: Repeatable game production quality systems
- [statement] Kylin recommends naming and counting card faces and shared backs in a manifest; publisher Frank West independently describes counting cards and checking order, duplicates and the rulebook component list. (medium confidence) — https://m.kylinmanufactory.com/news/Board_Game_Pieces/Board_Game_Card_Stock_Guide_GSM_Core_Finish_and_Durability.html · keywords: Repeatable game production quality systems · also: https://thecityofkings.com/news/requesting-samples-from-your-manufacturer/
- [statement] Kylin requires a reference and viewing condition for colour tolerances; Tianyi Shengtang says its achievable numeric colour tolerance depends on the specific colour, substrate and structure. Neither passage supplies a universal tolerance for this game. (medium confidence) — https://m.kylinmanufactory.com/news/Board_Game_Pieces/Board_Game_Card_Stock_Guide_GSM_Core_Finish_and_Durability.html · keywords: Repeatable game production quality systems · also: https://tystprinting.com/quality/

## How it works

- [statement] Tianyi Shengtang describes taking colour readings during production and stopping the press when readings exceed tolerance; it says batch records link finished goods to material, ink, press-run and inspection records. These are supplier-described controls. (low confidence) — https://tystprinting.com/quality/ · keywords: Repeatable game production quality systems

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] Use representative random samples for lot decisions. NIST describes random lot selection; Minitab also recommends random selection representative of the whole lot, including stratification where needed. (high confidence) — https://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/handbook/pmc/section2/pmc21.htm · keywords: Repeatable game production quality systems · also: https://support.minitab.com/en-us/minitab/help-and-how-to/quality-and-process-improvement/acceptance-sampling/how-to/attributes-acceptance-sampling/before-you-start/data-considerations/

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] PrintNinja’s terms updated July 14, 2022 treat an order with under 2% defective copies as complete; above 2% the stated remedy may be a prorated refund or replacement printing, at its discretion, with defect reports due within 90 days. The passage does not resolve the exactly-2% boundary. (low confidence) (verified as of 2022-07-14) — https://printninja.com/about/terms/ · keywords: Repeatable game production quality systems

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Level 99 Games’ support article, modified on 21 Aug, 2023, excludes slight miscuts under 2 mm from replacements for normal minor printing damage. That publisher’s service threshold is not evidence that every game should accept the same dimensional error. (low confidence) (verified as of 2023-08-21) — https://support.level99games.com/support/solutions/articles/65000067116-help-my-game-is-missing-parts-or-was-shipped-with-damage- · keywords: Repeatable game production quality systems

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Kylin describes a golden sample as an approved, controlled physical reference retained for production, used alongside written tolerances rather than replacing them. This is manufacturer guidance, not an independently measured quality result. (low confidence) — https://www.kylinmanufactory.com/news/Designing_A_Board_Game/Board_Game_Preproduction_Sample_Approval_Guide.html · keywords: Repeatable game production quality systems
- [statement] Acceptance sampling is primarily for deciding whether a lot is likely acceptable, rather than estimating its quality. NIST distinguishes this immediate lot decision from long-run quality control, while QIMA describes AQL as risk management. A passed sample therefore must not be presented as a measured defect rate for the entire shipment. (medium confidence) — https://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/handbook/pmc/section2/pmc21.htm · keywords: Repeatable game production quality systems · also: https://www.qima.com/aql-acceptable-quality-limit
- [statement] QIMA describes reinspection after corrections are completed to check the batch against the agreed AQL before shipment. This supports a correction-and-verification step rather than treating the first inspection report as final closure. (low confidence) — https://www.qima.com/aql-acceptable-quality-limit · keywords: Repeatable game production quality systems
- [statement] Minitab recommends agreeing both AQL and RQL with the supplier; its guidance describes acceptance and rejection probabilistically rather than as certainty. (low confidence) — https://support.minitab.com/en-us/minitab/help-and-how-to/quality-and-process-improvement/acceptance-sampling/how-to/attributes-acceptance-sampling/before-you-start/data-considerations/ · keywords: Repeatable game production quality systems
- [statement] Kylin recommends new approval after a mill or stock change, rather than accepting a similar marketing name. (low confidence) — https://m.kylinmanufactory.com/news/Board_Game_Pieces/Board_Game_Card_Stock_Guide_GSM_Core_Finish_and_Durability.html · keywords: Repeatable game production quality systems

## Facts and statements

- [statement] For reprints, Kylin recommends comparing the new lot against the retained sample and prior data, and confirming that artwork, materials, tools and subcontractors have not changed. (low confidence) — https://www.kylinmanufactory.com/news/Safety_Tests_for_Games/Board_Game_Quality_Control_The_Publisher_s_Inspection_Checklist.html · keywords: Repeatable game production quality systems
- [statement] Honray’s published defect scheme treats defects that make a game unusable, incomplete or unsellable as major, and cosmetic imperfections without gameplay impact as minor. These are its published categories, not a universal project-specific acceptance agreement. (low confidence) — https://www.honraygames.com/quality-control/ · keywords: Repeatable game production quality systems
- [statement] In its January 5, 2023 Turing Machine incident notice, Hachette relayed Scorpion Masqué’s report of missing or damaged inserts and stated that files for future prints had been reviewed with the factory to correct the insert issue. This is an attributed corrective-action account, not proof of an achieved defect rate. (low confidence) — https://www.hachetteboardgames.com/blogs/infos/turing-machine-1st-printing-issues · keywords: Repeatable game production quality systems
- [statement] PRINTING United Alliance describes system certification around a defined configuration that includes the engine, DFE, software and applicable materials, and requires recertification after major hardware or software upgrades. Certification evidence should therefore be checked against the configuration actually used. (low confidence) — https://idealliance.org/systems-certification/g7-press-control-system-certification/ · keywords: Repeatable game production quality systems
- [statement] Retain a coded approved physical reference for repeat orders. Kylin recommends retaining the chosen sample and its purchase-specification code; Tianyi Shengtang says it logs approved samples against production batches. (medium confidence) — https://m.kylinmanufactory.com/news/Board_Game_Pieces/Board_Game_Card_Stock_Guide_GSM_Core_Finish_and_Durability.html · keywords: Repeatable game production quality systems · also: https://tystprinting.com/quality/
- [statement] Kylin recommends defining allowable cutting, registration, colour and finishing variation separately from functional defects, and using manifests, sorting, weight checks and random full-deck verification for count and collation. This is manufacturer guidance, not an independently measured yield. (low confidence) — https://m.kylinmanufactory.com/news/Board_Game_Pieces/Board_Game_Card_Stock_Guide_GSM_Core_Finish_and_Durability.html · keywords: Repeatable game production quality systems
- [statement] Protect retained reference samples from environmental change. Kylin recommends flat archive storage away from sunlight, heat and handling; RIT explains that heat, light and pollutants can fade prints or shift their colour. (medium confidence) — https://m.kylinmanufactory.com/news/Board_Game_Pieces/Board_Game_Card_Stock_Guide_GSM_Core_Finish_and_Durability.html · keywords: Repeatable game production quality systems · also: https://www.rit.edu/ipi/dp3/fade
